reviews.text:
I honestly couldn’t recommend Hackney Barkers enough. I completed my Level 2 and Level 3 dog grooming training here and have loved every minute of it.

The trainers are incredibly knowledgeable, patient and supportive, and I’ve come away feeling genuinely confident in my grooming skills. I’ve learnt so much, not just about grooming itself but also about handling different dogs, breed-specific requirements and working safely and professionally.

I’m now taking the next step towards opening my own grooming business, and I know the training and experience I’ve had here have given me a really solid foundation to build on. Thank you to the whole team for all your support! 🤎

My little senior dog Frankie has been going to Hackney Barkers for over 2 years. The team are lovely and gentle with him and he now enjoys his pamper sessions and looks great after his groom. A fantastic service 😃

Wonderful result my dog Ziggy looks and smells amazing, can't recommend more, dealt with Courtney and she was very kind and helpful and explained how he was through the groom.
Great place!
The team at Hackney Barkers are the best! Wouldn't go anywhere else for my dog's groom.
Think the smile on Yuki says everything. Absolutely incredible groomers, my boys always come out looking amazing

Wow! I am so impressed with the service and results from hackney barkers- really accomodating and understanding when i had to postpone the appointment. Lovely grooming area where you can see them at work. The results of his sonic teeth cleaning are beyond expectations- have removed so much plaque. We have been to another groomer for this service who did not remove as much- will be back for a top up!
Amazing team and my dog comes back perfectly groomed!
Love this place! Have been bringing out dogs here for a couple years, and they are always handled with such sweet care. The staff are all top-notch, and our pets always come away looking beautiful.
The only groomers I’d ever trust with my dog! Coco has the best time whenever she comes to get groomed and she always leaves looking and smelling incredible ❤️
